# Re-verification of the stored interval covers with the amended verifier (generated by experiments/theory_t1b_reverify.py)

Referee round T1b (findings 2 and 5).  `verify` now asserts r > d_0, the block critical point in D-hat and theta < v_#, tests E_j < D_j/1.0001 (strict), and uses the upper end of a ball where it used to substitute 0 for an undecided one.  Each cover is recomputed from the stored top exponent (attempt budget 2400 s per target; the stored run used 240 s) and compared with Part Q of theory_t1b.md.
